methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2016 10-K); 'Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast

theme_watch.reason: Live: Comcast's own FY2016 10-K says 'Changes in consumer behavior driven by new technologies and distribution platforms for viewing content may adversely affect our businesses and challenge existing business models. Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services.' At the same time it streams to its own video customers: 'Through our mobile apps and online portal, we offer streaming services that allow our video customers to view certain live programming and On Demand content, browse program listings, and schedule and manage DVR recordings'. The stock trades at 22.3x FY17E — a premium. The theme registry dates the market's pricing of streaming to 2015-08-04 (Disney lowers cable-network outlook on ESPN subscriber losses; media stocks sell off), evidence that names Disney's networks, not Comcast. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (STREAMING) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing streaming substitution of Comcast's video customers or networks specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2016 10-K); 'Many of these service offerings charge no fee or a lower fee than our traditional video packages for access to their content, which could have an adverse effect on demand for our video services, including for expanded digital video packages, premium networks, and our DVR and On Demand services'; 'Weak economic conditions may have a negative impact on our businesses'; STREAMING is live (from 2015-08-04) and its consumer-behaviour risk factor puts it on the watch list: company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Comcast. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.94x; +49% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.41; conservative 2yr -5%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.7%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.8%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +25.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2017-05-19) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 1.94x (40.8% downside to Bear $23 / +21.0% upside to Bull $47) | Adj composite 1.87 vs market 3.28: gap -1.41 [OVERVALUED] | +49% above the EPP floor $26 (15x FY17E $1.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: -5.0% total (-2.5%/yr) | At 22.3x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $51 sits above the BULL case; video subscribers +0.7% in Q1 2017, forward revenues +8.9% (no FY17 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2017 revenue growth); streaming is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
